Results.ReviewText:
I've lived with this cooker for over a year now, (2 summers) and I think 4 stars is a very fair review for it. First of all, it feels high-quality, the interface is easier to use and the app is elite! Plenty of cooking space and the cooker hold temps precisely. I've even smoked in about 20 degree weather on a couple of times and this cooker  holds temps without any help from thermal blankets or any other tricks or accessories. I've very happy with the quality overall, and the general experience with this smoker. 

The Cons: This thing chews through pellets like crazy. Doesn't matter if you use theirs, or other high-quality pellets. I just smoked a Pork butt for 10 hours yesterday and used 3/4 of a bag of Treager pellets. Which are not cheap mind you. So yeah, it holds temps well, but it will eat away at your hopper. For what it's worth, I ONLY use this to smoke and the temp rarely ever exceeds 275 on it. I can only image how fast it eats up pellets if you try using this as a grill. 

The other con, which is actually just really annoying.. is because of the position of the hopper measurement laser letting you know how full of pellets it is, is directly over the hole where the pellets get fed into the firebox... It's contantly yelling at me that my hopper is low on pellets. Meanwhile, a mountain of them are still in there, it's just that the laser is pointing at the lowest possible part of the hopper. So I go outside, slide the pellets down and even them out and it's fine. But it's really annoying to deal with. You never actually know how many pellets are in the hopper because you can't trust this measurement. I have on occasion, ignored the notice that my hopper is low because of this problem realizing eventually the mountain of pellets would tumble down on their own, just to realize it actually is low and I need to put more pellets in. I with you could move the little measuring laser to a different spot in the hopper. 

One more thing not necessarily about this cooker, that is common but I wish someone would fix. I bought the accessory tray that snaps onto the front so that I have a little bit of space when putting stuff on/off the cooker. However, the handle to open the lid sticks out pretty far. So like... 25% of the space I gained from buying this tray, is gone because the handle is blocking it. I wish someone would figure out putting that type of accessory on one of the sides so it sticks out like an "L" shape. Prep on the shelf, and then 90 degree turn right onto the cooker.
Results.Title: After a Year of Living with It

Since you’re already using Super Smoke, try keeping cooks between 185°F and 225°F, using the upper rack, and giving the food a longer exposure to the smoke. Results.ReviewText:
Hours after we shut down our Traeger Woodridge Pro pellet grill and believed it had completely cooled, we began smelling smoke. To our surprise, the pellets in the hopper had ignited. We immediately opened the pellet-release door and emptied the burning/smoldering pellets into a pail of water.

What concerns me most is that this happened hours after the grill had been turned off. Had our windows not been open and we hadn't noticed the smell of smoke, I don't know how far this could have progressed. It appears that pellets can ignite or smolder in the auger and potentially spread back into the hopper, which is extremely concerning.

The following morning, I attempted to turn the grill on. The power switch lights up, but the digital display remains completely dark and the grill is nonfunctional. Given what happened, I am concerned that internal components or electronics may have been damaged.

I contacted Traeger and requested either a replacement grill or an authorized service technician to inspect it. I was told that neither a complete replacement nor an in-home service visit was an option. Instead, the proposed solution was to send me replacement parts that I would be expected to install myself—including potentially replacing electronics, controls, or other internal components.

This is where I have a serious problem with the warranty experience. After an incident involving smoke and burning pellets inside the hopper, I don't believe a customer should be expected to diagnose the cause and start replacing electrical and control components. In my opinion, a qualified technician should determine why the hopper incident occurred in the first place before the grill is put back into service.

I spent approximately $800 on this Woodridge Pro less than a year ago, so this is extremely disappointing. My biggest concern isn't simply that the grill stopped working; it's that I no longer have confidence in its safety. Replacing parts may get the grill operating again, but it doesn't necessarily explain why pellets were burning in the hopper hours after shutdown.

I'm replacing this grill with a Weber propane grill because, after this experience, I'm simply not comfortable continuing to use it.

Does this incident indicate an inherent problem with the product? I can't make that determination. I can only describe what happened with my grill. Based on my experience, however, I no longer have confidence in the safety of this product and am out the 800 dollars I spent.
Results.Title: Warning - Safety / Fire Issue  - Hopper Fire

ClientResponses.Response: Hey Brian, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback; we appreciate it. We understand your concern about the temperature readings. Traeger grills use built-in temperature sensors that work with model-specific algorithms to estimate the average temperature across the cooking area. Third-party thermometers, including oven thermometers, infrared thermometers, ambient sensors on meat probes, and even Traeger meat probes, are designed and calibrated differently from the grill's built-in temperature sensor. Because of this, third-party thermometer readings should not be used to evaluate grill performance, as they may differ from the temperature displayed on the controller. Temperature fluctuations within approximately ±25°F are a normal part of grill operation and help produce Traeger's signature wood-fired flavor. If you are experiencing any inconvenience beyond the temperature readings, we would like to know more about it. Please feel free to contact our Customer Support team through the Support section on our website using chat or by calling 1-800-TRAEGER. Traeger

Results.ReviewText:
I BBQ part-time professionally, primarily using larger wood and charcoal smokers.  Historically, I haven't really had much interest in pellet smokers. Not for any reason other than I simply enjoy the process of tending fires. I am, however, quite surprised, and not even a little embarrassed to admit how much I enjoy using my Traeger Woodridge Pro. In addition to the obvious convenience advantage compared to woodburning cookers, there is a great deal more to like about it... 

The controls are straightforward and very easy to use. The large, retro "8-bit"-style display is easy to see, even from a distance. The app is super intuitive and cleanly designed, without a lot of fluff or clutter between you and getting cooking. I appreciate that it uses Wi-Fi (rather than the more common Bluetooth), as Wi-Fi enables you to view and control a cook from anywhere you have cellular or Wi-Fi service! YES, I have indeed managed a cook, from a vehicle (as a passenger, of course), about 90 miles from home! The temperatures across the cook chamber, and top to bottom, are within reasonable differences. And the built-in food probe seems accurate when compared with my various 3rd-party leave-in thermometers.

Initially, I found the remaining pellet warning (a feature not included on the base model Woodridge) a little annoying. But I have to be honest, it's saved my “bacon” (almost literally) more than once! I got the alert when I was away from home toward the end of a long cook. And I was able to call a neighbor to come over and fill up the hopper!

While it may seem like a small thing to get excited about, it’s without doubt, THE easiest-to-clean pellet smoker I've ever used. Almost to the point of being enjoyable. There are hooks on the cooker body and framework where you can hang all the grates, including the primary drip tray, while you clean the inside. And unlike most other pellet smokers, there are no dark, hard-to-reach places inside. Once you remove the firepot cover, grease channel, and ash/grease keg cover (which all simply lift out with no contortions or gyrations required!), everything can be easily scraped or swept into the catch keg, then removed and dumped. Reading this as I'm writing it, it doesn't sound that easy. BUT TRUST ME, it really is incredibly easy. 

With all of these advantages, the REAL STANDOUT feature of the Woodridge for me is the way it cooks. Most horizontal, or what I call “offset style” (meaning a horizontal, barrel-style cook chamber with a pellet hopper to the side) pellet smokers have a tremendous issue with radiant heat, and cook more like an oven than a smoker, resulting in what I consider a less-than-optimal texture to your cooked food - ESPECIALLY BRISKETS, where I find the output from most pellet smokers to be noticeably "pot-roasty." 

What I'm assuming is happening with the Woodridge is that with the lighter weight and steeper angle of the primary drip tray, it's cooking more with convected (like a traditional offset smoker) than radiant heat. Whatever the actual contribution, the briskets I'm getting from my Woodridge are closer to traditional offset quality than I've ever had from a pellet smoker.

As far as anything negative to say. If you're planning to use this as much (or more) for grilling than smoking, this may not be the best choice for you. Not having any function for direct firepot access, you're limited to a max cook temp of about 500ºF. So you're not going to get that dark char that people are typically after. Not that you can't cook a decent steak or burger on it, but if I were looking to grill more than smoke, I'd probably be looking at another cooker.

Now I'm not ready to replace all my live-fire cookers with pellet smokers. But I did use it on customers' turkey cooks this holiday season (all of which turned out great!). And on the days I don't have the time, energy, or inclination to tend a fire, and just want some great food, the Woodridge has changed my thinking about pellet smokers, and has certainly earned its place in my lineup.
Results.Title: Woodrigde Pro: From a Stickburner's perspective...

ClientResponses.Response: Hey Mike, thanks for sharing your experience. When the grill shows an overheating message and struggles to hold temperature, it is often reacting to conditions that make it think temps have exceeded its safety limit, such as grease buildup, pellet buildup in the firepot, strong wind hitting the exhaust, or even settings like cooking at very high temps with frequent lid openings. A good place to start is giving the grill a thorough clean, especially the firepot and grease areas, then making sure it is running the latest firmware and completing a self test from the controller menu to confirm everything is communicating correctly. It also helps to position the grill so wind is not blowing directly into the exhaust and to allow the shutdown cycle to fully complete before restarting. Taking these steps usually brings temperature performance back to normal, and if you want help walking through it or checking settings, we are here for you at 1-800-TRAEGER. TRAEGER

ClientResponses.Response:
Hi Joshua, thanks for the comment.ER 10 showing up right before a brisket cook is brutal and losing a $140 cut is incredibly frustrating. That code appears when the grill isn’t able to ignite within the expected time. The igniter is the most common cause, although a blocked firepot or restricted airflow can lead to the same result. In the majority of cases, replacing the igniter restores normal lighting and controller failures are far less common.
Before a long cook, a quick preheat check can help catch anything early. Make sure the firepot is clear, pellets are dry and feeding, the fan is moving air, and the igniter begins to heat within the first couple of minutes. If it doesn’t glow, an igniter replacement is the right next step.
We want your grill to be dependable every time you fire it up and we understand how moments like this can impact a cook you were looking forward to.
Traeger Support

The Traeger wireless probes would never pair.  Hours were spent with Customer Support trying to resolve the problem.  Traeger sent replacement wireless probes (I now have 4 probes, all brand new sitting on a shelf),  I replaced the control display/head with no success.  I would caution everyone about buying them because I'm not the only one having this problem.  On multiple forums this problem appears and it seems the pairing problem is centered around primarily the Woodridge series.  I'm hoping it's a firmware problem that can be fixed soon.  In the meantime the wire probes work great so I'll just continue to use them.

Results.ReviewText: I highly recommend buying from ACE Hardware because they assembled my Traeger Woodridge Pro and deliver for free!  Make sure you do the burn-in correctly!  It does take a while to get to temperature when you first use it but gets better.  Have been enjoying smoked ribs, brisket and pork but.  The Trager 3,2,1 ribs are perfect.  If you like a chewy rib take off at 195.  If you want fall off the bone, take off at 205.  Also turn off super smoke during wrapping meats.  Super-smoke is a waste of pellets during that phase.  Love my Traeger grill/smoker.  Can't wait to apple wood smoke a turkey for Thanksgiving!

Results.ReviewText: This is the best pellet smoker I’ve ever used bar none. I had a competitors grill for quite some time and I needed a part. Well the part never came in and I decided to move on to Traeger. After lots of research, my wife and I decided on the Woodbridge Pro. We are so happy with our choice. I recently smoked a brisket for the 1st time. With the help of Matt Pittman from Meat Church, it came out spectacular!!!!!! The app is really user friendly and all the recipes and videos are brilliant. I’d recommend this grill to anyone. You won’t be disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: I happened to catch the Labor Day sale after I had the base model Woodridge in my cart.  I upgraded to the Pro for the shelf and better wheel set which I appreciate.  The carton arrived well organized and the unpacking and assembly was sort of fun for my kids and me.  The grill was assembled in an hour and all was well.  I smoked some salmon and grilled burgers and shrimp to the delight of my family using the Traeger recipes all at the same time due to the large capacity.  My first smoke was a 10 lb Boston Butt that cooked perfectly using the Traeger recipe and rubs.  It was pouring down rain and I was grateful for the WiFi cooking timers and temperature controls.  Nice bark, deep smoke ring (and flavor), and very juicy.  The wired temparture probe worked well and, even though I lost power twice, the grill recovered quickly and the meat was perfect.  The only negative was the inability or the Traeger wireless probe to pair.  Customer service provided a return shipping label via support chat in seconds.  Otherwise, this grill is built llike a submarine and should provide years of tasty service putting meat on my table.  I look forward to trying the different flavor of pellets and can highly recommend the Woodridge Pro.  Oh yeah, very easy to clean!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a Traeger Woodridge Pro about 3 months ago and its my first Smoker/Pellet Grill. I have been using a Weber Genesis for years and usually only cook for my wife and I but maybe 4 times per year I will cook for a family of 4 in addition to us. Capacity wasn't an issue, Construction is mostly good however I do wish the bottom plate that connects all 4 legs didn't seem like it would end up being the first part to begin to rust away because so much water collects on it anytime it rains. I purchased a Traeger Woodridge Pro OEM cover for it and while it is high quality I definitely concerned about the water collecting on the flat spots where the shelf and pellet bin are. As for Cooking, the wifi is great, I definitley love that and it cooked the best chicken I've had. It's ignition process was a little less intuitive than I had hoped but after I read the owners manual I was able to get the hang of it. As for Temperature.... It takes a while to get up to temperature especially when its raining/windy but holds it well until you open it for 20 seconds or more, then it takes a while to get back up again so its' a vicious cycle unless you set it and forget it to let the app and meat probes handle it all. I like not accidentally burning the meat like I had done on my Weber a few times but the chicken sometimes had a tough rubbery skin when I smoked it for too long or when the grill lid was open too long and the grill went all the way down to 95 degrees and took 20 minutes to get back up to temperature. Overall I'm happy with the purchase but I'll hang on to my Weber grill also so I can cook stuff hot and quick every now and again.

My first cook was Mother’s Day when I did 10 racks of baby backs!  They were great!  I love the easy start up, remote monitoring, super smoke, easy clean and shutdown!  It doesn’t get much easier!
Results.Title: Woodbridge Pro

Results.ReviewText: Amazing product that has more than delivered on what it advertised. Love to ease and app control. It was a god send for smoking and bbqing in south Florida during the summer. Being able to monitor from the comfort of the house is a game changer from the offset days. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: A must have grill for hot weather cookouts.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first smoker. Everything about it is a joy. From assembling it to connecting it to using it. My first smoke was a brisket and it turned out perfect. I got the recipe from a Traeger video. Even that was not only informative but fun to watch.
Results.Title: My First Smoker

Results.ReviewText: After using a pro34 for 8 years its unbelievable how more efficient and versatile the Woodridge Pro is. Love it
Results.Title: Awesome and affordable pellet smoker.

Results.ReviewText: I love this smoker. This is the easiest and most sophisticated grill. Set it, and forget it. Come back when the smoker alerts you that it's done.
Results.Title: Worth every dollar!

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Traeger Grill purchase! We fired it up today and made steaks on it. The steaks turned out amazing!! We will be using it alot this summer!!
Results.Title: Great Features

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to put together and works great! Can’t wait to use the app.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Works great!  Really love the super smoke mode!  Like how easy it was to connect to my phone..  Can monitor everything from the phone.
Results.Title: Easy to use!

Results.ReviewText:
This is my first smoker of any kind.  It went together easily.  Great instructions and packages labeled appropriately.  Connecting to wifi and the app was simple.  followed to a T.  I have cooked on it 3 times in over 1 week.  I noticed it goes through a lot of pellets.  However, this is a large cooking area, 860 sq in.  It seemed to hold the heat well.  I had a lot of wind one day, and that seemed to effect the temperature.  So far i like what this can do.  Looking forward to playing more with recipes.  Very happy with this grill, especially in the price range.  
a nice feature is you can use 2 plug in probes and add 2 more bluetooth probes and they all connect to your app.  Easy stuff.
Results.Title: First time smoker owner

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill holds temp the extra grill size is awesome
Results.Title: The Pro

Results.ReviewText:
Assembly took between hour and a half and two hours which wasn’t bad. Currently seasoning and burning off the packing grease. Excited to cook with it.

Delivery was easy although I wasn’t notified on delivery by LTL company so it just appeared at end of my driveway one day on a pallet which coincided with 3 weeks worth of rain which was bad luck.
Results.Title: Good

Results.ReviewText: This is my first ever smoker, and it is incredible. I was looking for something very low maintenance as I have a young family. This grill is very easy to clean, do not have to babysit the food and I can focus my attention elsewhere. Just cooked a Turkey for Easter and turned out incredible. Entire family was impressed. I have cooked in all types of temperatures as I am in Ontario, Canada. The temperature really recovers fast and excellent value for the price.
Results.Title: Incredible

Results.ReviewText: Picked up Woodridge Pro this weekend. Assembly was straight forward with good instructions.  Seasoning was a simple process.  Made some simple Baby Back ribs. Compared to a charcoal smoker I used previously ribs were night and day.  Great flavor and smoker performance's  was exceptional.  Upgrade to a pellet smoker was well worth the money.
Results.Title: Enjoyable Weekend

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Woodridge Pro pellet grill a little over a month ago.  Overall, the grill has worked out well for me.  It's easy to clean and maintain than any other grills that I have owned.  The only concern I have, is that it takes about 45 minutes to preheat.  I have contacted support and told me that it's normal for the newer pellet grills to take that long since they are touchscreen.  Other then the time it takes to preheat the grill is great and I would highly recommend it!
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great product and so easy to use. Highly recommend this for anyone who wants to get 10/10 flavor with the freedom to go about your day and monitor everything from your phone. Additionally I recommend getting the Pro for the extra shelf, it really comes in handy.
Results.Title: Meat made easy

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a while back great capacity, easy to construct and gets hot and ready to cook almost instantly.
Results.Title: The grill is amazing

Results.ReviewText: So glad I picked the Traeger Woodbridge pro!! It was very easy to assemble and had great instructions!!! The smoker works effortlessly and my meat was smoked to perfection!!!!
Results.Title: Best pellet smoker ever

Results.ReviewText: I recently bought the Woodridge Pro and it works wells overall.  It’s easy to clean and maintain.  The only thing I’m not a big fan of is it takes about 45 minutes for it to pre-heat even in ideal weather conditions.  I’ve called support a few times about this and I was told that’s normal operations with the touchscreen pellet grills.  I was told this even though it’s advertised that it takes 15 to 20 minutes to pre-heat in ideal weather conditions.  Overall though I would still recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Would recommend

Results.ReviewText: Works great! I like the app and super smoke feature.
Results.Title: Amazing

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Woodridge pro like a month ago and it is unreal. So versatile. I’ve wanted to get into more smoking meats but the all day process has limited my availability. Now, I can change temps with any meat whenever, at work! Man this thing makes plain old barbecues a thing of the past. Wood fired flavour even when you don’t smoke. It really is awesome and easy to use. I’m looking forward to straight up smoking salmon when I get some more in my freezer this year. I’d have to say the pellet sensor, extra grilling space and extra side shelf is well worth the $200 extra. I just wish I could get all the Traeger sauces and rubs here in Canada.
Results.Title: Mind blowing

Results.ReviewText: Had a lot of fun assembling this grill, instructions are awesome suggesting a 6 pack is recommended as I only drank 3 by the time I was done. Only had one issue with front bracket inside screw not lining up for side shelf  was able to get it. Setting up wifi and App was easy and user friendly! Nice addition to the deck with my Big Green Egg!
Results.Title: Smokers Heaven

Results.ReviewText: Can’t beat the quality would recommend! Works great super user friendly would absolutely buy again.
Results.Title: Best bang for your buck!

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill. Amazing directions. Very easy for my wife and I to put it together. Cooked a few steaks and chicken breasts and they came out perfect. Only problem so far has been hooking up the WiFi. Can’t get it to work yet. I think the bricks around my house may be interfering with it. I will move the grill in front of my windows and see if that helps get it working.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the Woodridge Pro and all of the new features  !!
Results.Title: LOVE IT !!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your review. While weather can play a role in how your grill works, there are ways to make sure your cook runs smoothly. For a windy day, place your grill out of the wind's direct path. Humidity from rain might cause the ignition to take longer but clean the fire pot of sawdust and ash to make it easier. When it is really hot keep the grill out of the direct sun and in cold weather you might use more pellets to maintain the temp. The ignition might take longer and the screen can be darker. With all of the weather conditions, we recommend cooking to internal temp vs time.  You can check our support site to see if your grill has a compatible insulation blanket and to learn about weather effects on grilling.
